reviews.text: Dr. V is amazing! Just be prepared for a little scolding if you aren't doing the right thing. He is great with my Bernedoodle, and I always know we're in good hands. The staff, including the front end, are always helpful and professional. #vet #bernedoodle #petcare 🐾🩺 …
Very friendly staff and the Vet is the best. Prices are reasonable and the wait is worth it. Don't even complain lol

What a horrible experience. I needed a diagnosis and testing for my extremely gentle senior dog & I got a recommendation to come here for cost efficiency. No appointments allowed & we sat outside in the rain for 3 hours. Then we get in and they muzzle my dog (he’s never shown an ounce of aggression), then flip him on his back on a table. They literally held him like this the entire time and they weren’t even examining him half the time, just talking. He was shaking and terrified, it made me cry.

Every time I tried to speak, ask a question, or simply respond to him (like with a “okay” or “right”, the vet told me to shut up with his hand up. I was legitimately shocked & it takes a LOT to offend me. He sent me off with some weird hand written note that was completely illegible. I’ve been trying to get the records from his bloodwork for his new vet and can’t even get someone to answer the phone.
our 2 cat so sick fiver. dr v  take good care of  our cat .  very good doctor.,

This doctor had the audacity to push his fingers into my left shoulder as he was speaking to me about my dog. It is utterly disrespectful and rude to touch a CUSTOMER. He is patronizing; he told me to look away and not make a face while drawing blood from my dog as if I was a little girl. He is clearly sexist and misogynistic. I don’t not feel anywhere NEAR safe as a young women in this office.

I highly recommend you don’t come here
Best vet ever!! The Dr knew exactly what was wrong with my dog. Provided meds and now my dog feels much better.

They do a great job and take the time to figure out what's wrong with our pets, and their prices are reasonable. I moved to New Jersey, and the prices are ridiculously expensive, and most of the time they treat my dogs like just another number. Because they're always in a hurry, they don't investigate thoroughly, and they misdiagnosed my dog. Even though I had to travel for an hour and a half, I went back to Forest Animal Hospital because I've taken my dogs there since they were puppies, and they fixed his problem in just one visit.

Excellent place! The prices are very affordable, and the service has been amazing. They have helped me so much with my kitten and have always been kind, attentive, and professional. You can tell they truly care about animals. 🐱💗 Highly recommend! …

Awful. Horrible service. No respect from the receptionist and doctor. The owners and dogs were being mistreated. The waiting room was empty with the air conditioner on, but they forced to wait outside in the heat. For your animals sakes stay away.

Horrible experience. Do not go there. We went there and sat for three hours outside. They did not allow for us to come inside with our dog. Our dog was in bad condition and the receptionist did not even say hello or acknowledge us. She rudely told us to wait outside where is so hot that my dogs condition got even worse. Pet owners please do not risk you're animals health on this clinic. Go somewhere else.
Best doctor ever
I’ve been taking all my pets—dogs and cats—there for years, and they are excellent.
They are good
What would I do without Forest Animal Hospital!

Please stay away, especially if you own a cat. My husband and I were completely shocked at the rude and incompetent Dr. V. We waited 2 hours, which was fine. My cat stayed in her carrier, very quietly.  There are alot of people and 2hours seems long, but that's fine. We were called in. My cat had a slight ear issue, and we wanted Dr. V to check it, as she cried when cleaning herself, and my husband put drops, worked for a week, but she was back to the little crying out. Dr. V wouldn't allow my husband to take our cat out of the carrier. We said ok, that's his rule. In the meantime,  he was demanding answers, how old, how much water does she drink, has she lost weight? She's 11, we explained she maintained same weight for many years, he kept saying, a cat her age can have kidney disease, does she drink water? Yes, she eats the same, drinks the same. Then he brought up cancer, aids  In the meantime, a very young, inexperienced assistant was opening the carrier so slow, then took a huge towel, 2x the cat, and threw it on her, like to capture her. Naturally she got scared and cried. Immediately the Dr to her to sedate our cat, didn't ask us, or explain anything,  or ever look at her  My husband said my cat will be fine if I hold her, she's very calm. He yelled NO!  Said his insurance policy doesn't allow it. Well, why didn't you post a sign, tell us when we called 2x on phone,  and let us sit 2 hrs, then tell us? He said you don't want her sedated, I said for you to look at her ear, no. He yelled then go somewhere else down the street. Next patient  Wow, just wow. I've never been in such a stressful situation with my pet, I just want her to get medication for her ear. It's not discharging, no foul odor.  Maybe earwax blocked. I would never recommend anyone to him. And scaring me about cancer, and disease, like some motive to sedate her. Without ever looking or examining her. Assistant was maybe 20 yrs old at best, no medical gloves, no experience.  There was a sign up, looking for veterinary assistant. I bet he is. There was another girl behind me, did nothing, just kind of rolling her eyes at his demeanor. He needs to retire, very mean with cats, doesn't like them. It's hard to understand him, he's writing down nonsense on the paper, again, wanting to sedate her.  No.
I was shocked to say the least. Would highly recommend anyone to go elsewhere. He will see your dog, but afraid of Cats. Very disorganized office, not clean, waiting room is ok, but many people waiting outside in a heatwave, as there are not enough seats. Bathroom has no sink. Do they even wash their hands?
They use a live waiting list, so you have to come in and sign in. Call-ins don’t work, and the wait time can be long.
Excellent, I liked the service, everyone was very kind. I came for the first time and they took great care of my dog. I'm very happy and grateful.
My experience at the clinic was wonderful; the service was excellent, and it felt comfortable because they speak Spanish.
Been going here for over 15yrs . Dr V and staff are great . Prices are very reasonable. Highly recommmed
Dr V is the dog whisperer, great vet!

The BEST animal hospital in Staten Island. The doctor is hands on, you can tell that he loves animals. He teaches me something new every time I go there. And the prices are the BEST in the entire NYC. I love this Hospital, the doctor has such a BIG heart. The staffs are great. I just love this doctor, he is a GREAT man. Very passionate about his work. I can go on and on about this hospital. BEST VETERINARIAN EVER!
All I have to say is HIDDEN GEM!!!
Good service 👍🏻 …
Dr here works out great affordable prices. The only downside is there is no appointments, walk-ins only, so be prepared to wait hours to get seen .

Dr. V is a good veterinarian, but my main issue is that I often feel like I’m not being listened to during visits, which can be frustrating. I do appreciate the front desk staff—they are always friendly and I’ve never had any problems with them. However, the office itself could definitely be cleaner, as it doesn’t always feel as well-maintained as it should be. Overall, there are some positives, but also areas that could use improvement.

This vet was  obnoxiously  rude, when I brought my pet in the room he didn't  even listen  to what  I was  saying. Brought all xrays,blood  work  medicine  he was on disregarded  me and yelling at  me because  he thought  I was not taking care  of my pet. I had the vet at my house  at my house 4x
Only wanted second  opinion
He was telling  me my dog had infection not  true I will have  to tske his leg off. I had my friend as I witness.
Office  was dirty. Some one should look into this.  Anne
Thankful for this place 🙏 🙌 …

I have been coming here for years and for the last few visits I encountered a receptionist by the name of KELLY who has been extremely rude to me, but today she crossed the line when she cursed at me to my face for asking her a question. It’s a shame that they have people like her working here,  she lacks not only customer service skills but empathy towards pets. Dr. V needs to hire someone who is professional and has class.

We took in a yard cat...  Too many out there to take them all in. We named him tiger and he needed rescuing.  Wr went to another vet that was heavy on charges and light on interaction.   Forest animal, really shows they care about the pets.  The assistants were playing with our tiger, made him comfortable, gave advice on techniques as we are first time pet owners...  I do find owning a weird word to use cause our tiger picked us.  Well... The shory of it is. Good place for us.

Feb 7th at 2:20. I was left on hold for 15 min and when I politely asked if next time they can say, "we will call back" the receptionist said we are doing the best we can unapologetically and put me on hold again and left me on hold another 15 min.  The women was rude and when I asked why she was being so rude she hung up on me.  I am curious to who employs this type of service.  I didn't even get a chance to make an appointment and they lost a customer of two pets.  That is not how to run a local business on SI nor do I want someone like this in my community.

If I can give this doctor and his team a ZERO I would!  Horrifying experience!  My cat is a gentle cat, she may growl when she feels cornered or doesnt feel well but she has NEVER scratched or bit anyone.  The staff should not be afraid of a little cat!  She had been vomiting and when I tried to explain to the doctor that she seems to be coughing due to something in her esophogus he SHUT ME UP and told me to stand in the corner while he grabbed the cat, she growled and the staff tossed a net over her!  I was HORRIFIED but it only got WORSE from there!  He felt her abdomen and said she was NOT BLOCKED and told his staff to give her a shot of antibiotic (?) and anti nausea.  They did not allow me to hold her NOR DID THEY, they kept her squirming UNDER THE NET and one of the staff members the tall one with the big eyes, STARTED JABBING MY CAT as if she was in a SWORD FIGHT!  She jabbed her randomly and then pushed the needle in her.  The cat SCREAMED in PAIN!  I was in the absolute state of SHOCK!  I have NEVER WITNESSED such ANIMAL CRUELTY!  Because she was not being held properly this woman (tech?!) could have punctured a lung or a vital organ!  I had to bring my cat again to VERG 2 days later and they allowed me to hold her head as she PURRED and the doctor could not believe what this poor animal experienced!  They took an xray and discovered there WAS a PARTIAL BLOCKAGE and then I had to see another a few days later to check up again after FLUIDS were administered.  This new vet on SI also allowed me to hold her head and she PURRED and he also could NOT BELIEVE what a nightmare we had experienced!  He also gave her fluids and suggestions that were helpful and a better anti nausea medicine.  He was so gentle and LISTENED TO ME and did not SHUT ME UP.  She finally passed the paper towel she had swallowed that was giving her a difficult time. I proceeded to call the office of Dr V and Forest Ave and told them I would like to speak with Dr V. He REFUSED to speak with me and I told the receptionist to let him know how cruel his staff is and that I want  a refund of my visit and I would like him to call me. HE NEVER DID ! HE DOES NOT CARE!  All he cares about is vaccination and his POWER TRIP!  STAY AWAY!! KEEP YOUR ANIMAL SAFE from this MAD HOUSE! I am thinking about calling a lawyer or animal welfare on this practice before they harm another pet!
